description: Allows the addition, modification and deletion of checks in a Consul cluster using the agent. For more details on using and configuring Checks, see https://developer.hashicorp.com/consul/api-docs/agent/check.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Specifies command arguments to run to update the status of the check. Requires interval to be provided. Mutually exclusive with ttl, tcp and http.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Host of the Consul agent. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: http
parameters.description: Checks can be registered with an HTTP endpoint. This means that Consul checks that the HTTP endpoint returns a successful HTTP status. Requires interval to be provided. Mutually exclusive with args, ttl and tcp.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Specifies a unique ID for this check on the node. This defaults to the name parameter, but it may be necessary to provide an ID for uniqueness. This value is returned in the response as CheckId.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: The interval at which the service check is run. This is a number with a s or m suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes, for example 15s or 1m. If no suffix is supplied s is used by default, for example 10 is equivalent to 10s. Required if one of the parameters args, http, or tcp is specified.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required name for the service check.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Notes to attach to check when registering it.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which the consul agent is running. Default: 8500

parameters.name: scheme
parameters.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to http and can be set to https for secure connections. Default: "http"

parameters.name: service_id
parameters.description: The ID for the service, must be unique per node. If state=absent, defaults to the service name if supplied.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the check should be present or absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tcp
parameters.description: Checks can be registered with a TCP port. This means that Consul will check if the connection attempt to that port is successful (that is, the port is currently accepting connections). The format is host:port, for example localhost:80. Requires interval to be provided. Mutually exclusive with args, ttl and http.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: A custom HTTP check timeout. The Consul default is 10 seconds. Similar to the interval this is a number with a s or m suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes, for example 15s or 1m. If no suffix is supplied s is used by default, for example 10 is equivalent to 10s.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token to use for authorization.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Checks can be registered with a TTL instead of a args and interval this means that the service checks in with the agent before the TTL expires. If it does not the check is considered failed. Required if registering a check and the script an interval are missing Similar to the interval this is a number with a s or m suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes, for example 15s or 1m. If no suffix is supplied s is used by default, for example 10 is equivalent to 10s. Mutually exclusive with args, tcp and http.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Register tcp check for service 'nginx'
  community.general.consul_agent_check:
    name: nginx_tcp_check
    service_id: nginx
    interval: 60s
    tcp: localhost:80
    notes: "Nginx Check"

- name: Register http check for service 'nginx'
  community.general.consul_agent_check:
    name: nginx_http_check
    service_id: nginx
    interval: 60s
    http: http://localhost:80/status
    notes: "Nginx Check"

- name: Remove check for service 'nginx'
  community.general.consul_agent_check:
    state: absent
    id: nginx_http_check
    service_id: "{{ nginx_service.ID }}"

return_values.name: check
return_values.description: The check as returned by the Consul HTTP API. Returned: always Sample: {"CheckID": "nginx_check", "Interval": "30s", "Notes": "Nginx Check", "ServiceID": "nginx", "Type": "http"}

return_values.name: operation
return_values.description: The operation performed. Returned: changed Sample: "update"
